subject: Vendr onboarding: evidence entrance ticket & owner mapping
messages:
From: Sally Green <sally.green@acmefinancial.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: audits@acmefinancial.com
Date: Fri, 04 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr profile onboarding - entrance ticket and owner map request

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking this on. We're kicking off our vendor intake for Redwood and want to get a minimal entrance ticket in Vendr before the SOC 2 evidence window next month. Can you confirm the following items and who will own each?

- Current SOC 2 Type II report (latest period)
- SIG questionnaire (we map answers to our CAIQ crosswalk)
- CAIQ snapshot or mapping for the public controls
- SSO/service account proof (screenshot + metadata)
- S3/KMS proof of possession for evidence artifacts (manifest + presign window)

We would prefer files uploaded to Vendr and a short owner mapping spreadsheet so our security team can triage. Target timeline: entrance ticket by next Thursday (9/9) so we can include the profile in our evidence run.

Could you loop in whoever will do the uploads and who owns the SSO proof? Also share any presign windows you need for S3 evidence.

Appreciate it — happy to do a 15-min sync if helpful.

Sally Green
Security Program Manager
Acme Financial Services

P.S. We will request a short attestation during our review — nothing heavy, just acceptance that the artifacts are correct for the period stated.

From: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Sally Green <sally.green@acmefinancial.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 04 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr profile onboarding - entrance ticket and owner map request

Hi Sally — thanks for the clear ask.

Plan: I will own the intake and SIG/CAIQ mapping coordination. Marissa will handle the Vendr uploads and manifest grouping; Ben will own SSO/service-account evidence and the presign window. I'm attaching a simple owner_mapping_template.csv to capture who owns each artifact and where it will be uploaded (Vendr field / S3 path).

Immediate next steps we will take this morning:
- I will populate the template with contacts and target upload dates (ETA 9/7).
- Marissa will prepare an evidence_manifest_sample.xlsx to show grouping conventions we prefer (one artifact per row, metadata: control, period, path).
- Ben will provide SSO proof instructions and request a presign window for S3 (typically 2 business days).

Can you confirm Vendr is the preferred portal (you mentioned Vendr in the note) and whether the attestation can be a short email from our Security lead? If so we'll mark that in the owner map.

If helpful, I'm available for a 15-min sync today at 3pm PT; otherwise we'll proceed and update this thread with attachments and the owner map.

Thanks,

Irene Choi
Senior Security PM, Vendor Risk
Redwood Inference

Attachments: owner_mapping_template.csv (stub - please use to indicate owners and upload targets)

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, Sally Green <sally.green@acmefinancial.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 04 Sep 2027 13:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr profile onboarding - entrance ticket and owner map request

Thanks Irene / Sally — I'll take the Vendr upload sprint. Quick notes that should help your triage:

- Preferred grouping: one control-family folder in Vendr, artifacts named with prefix YYYYMM and control id (e.g. 202709-CC6-logging-sample.pdf).
- For SOC 2 reports we upload the redacted PDF and link to the SOC-portal reference in the manifest.
- For SIG/CAIQ we provide the completed questionnaire export + a CAIQ mapping sheet (we maintain a lightweight crosswalk).
- For screenshots (SSO) we prefer a short video + two screenshots (IdP metadata, SSO audit entry) to reduce back-and-forth.

I'm attaching an evidence_manifest_sample.xlsx to show the rows and metadata fields we populate.

I'll start the upload draft tomorrow morning and set provisional upload windows 9/7-9/8. Ben — can you confirm presign window duration and whether we need a temporary service account?

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Vendor Risk Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence_manifest_sample.xlsx (example manifest with sample rows)

From: Sally Green <sally.green@acmefinancial.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: audits@acmefinancial.com
Date: Sat, 05 Sep 2027 16:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr profile onboarding - entrance ticket and owner map request

Perfect — Vendr is our preferred portal. Attestation format: a single-line confirmation from your Security lead (email) that the artifacts reflect the stated period is fine.

On presign: we will provide a temporary S3 bucket + short-lived credentials for uploads; a 48-hour presign window works. We prefer no service-account creation on our side — we'll provide an upload manifest and presigned URLs.

Let's do the 15-min sync on Tuesday 9/7 at 10am ET / 7am PT to align on the owner map and confirm upload windows. I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the handoff.

Sally Green
Security Program Manager
Acme Financial Services
